explanation: The library defines `toFlasqueResolution F` as `(CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv (flasqueResolution F) F).symm ⟨(toFlasqueEnvelope (X := X)).app F, h⟩`, so the goal is exactly the instance of Mathlib's `CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv_symm_apply_f_zero` (which states, for `C : CochainComplex V ℕ`, `X : V` and `f : X ⟶ C.X 0` with `f ≫ C.d 0 1 = 0`, that `((fromSingle₀Equiv C X).symm ⟨f, hf⟩).f 0 = f`) at the specific map `(toFlasqueEnvelope (X := X)).app F`; the current proof applies that very lemma. Mathlib has no notion of flasque envelope/resolution (only `TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque`), so no Mathlib statement has this as its exact content — it is a one-line instantiation of the generic single-object lemma.
